title: Causal Localization of Evidence Effects in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.36524v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can controlled symbolic inputs reveal attention heads that influence a language model's decisions from natural language evidence? We introduce controlled evidence aggregation (CEA), which varies the counts and order of two symbols in otherwise fixed prompts and measures changes in a frozen Transformer's preference between two answer tokens. The preference is measured by their logit difference; the prompts prescribe no correct answer. Balanced utility causal selection (BUC) identifies compact head sets by jointly evaluating how much ablating their outputs removes the count effect and how closely patching mean outputs between count conditions recovers the effect in both directions. We derive conditional bounds linking head attribution to intervention effects and specifying when the attribution shortlist can be recovered from finite samples. In Pythia-410M, ablating sets of 1-12 heads selected separately for four ordering regimes removes 65

translated_title: Transformer中证据效应的因果定位
translated_abstract: 受控符号输入能否揭示那些影响语言模型基于自然语言证据做出决策的注意力头？我们提出了受控证据聚合（CEA）方法，该方法在其余内容保持固定的提示中改变两个符号的数量和顺序，并测量冻结的Transformer对两个答案词元的偏好变化。偏好通过二者的logit差异来衡量；提示中不规定任何正确答案。平衡效用因果选择（BUC）通过联合评估两方面来识别紧凑的头集合：一是消融这些头的输出能在多大程度上消除数量效应，二是在不同数量条件之间修补平均输出能在多大程度上双向恢复该效应。我们推导了将头归因与干预效应联系起来的条件界，并明确了何时可以从有限样本中恢复归因候选列表。在Pythia-410M模型中，针对四种排序情形分别选择的1-12个注意力头的消融集合消除了65%（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出受控证据聚合（CEA）与平衡效用因果选择（BUC）方法，在Pythia-410M模型中通过因果干预定位出驱动语言模型利用自然语言证据进行决策的关键注意力头集合，并提供了从有限样本恢复归因结果的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Controlled Evidence Aggregation (CEA) and Balanced Utility Causal Selection (BUC) to causally localize compact sets of attention heads that drive a language model's decisions from natural language evidence in Pythia-410M, with conditional guarantees on recovering attribution shortlists from finite samples.
